title: Broken Doll and Smiling Orbs
description: A broken porcelain doll with a hollow screaming mouth lies on the floor of a dark decaying hallway, one arm raised. To the right, three eerie stylized female figures with spiral eyes and melting faces float above a glowing green smiley face orb that casts light on a pile of dark debris and smaller smiley faces on the ground.
prompt: A surreal horror scene in a dark decaying hallway with peeling walls covered in graffiti. In the foreground, a broken white porcelain doll with a giant hollow screaming mouth lies on its back with one arm raised. To the right, three floating eerie female figures with spiral hypnotic eyes, black tears, and melting features hover above a glowing green smiley face orb emitting light. Below the orb is a pile of dark rubble and smaller smiley faces, high contrast black and white with selective green glow, unsettling atmosphere.
